'''Phillip Roy''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2001 Spokane tournament]] on 1 June 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Old School Hunt Down Duels]], according to Evan Walker's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2400">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-01-spokane-wa-6-1-01d2400/ spokane-wa-6-1-01], DeckTech (Evan "EvO" Walker, 1 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-01-spokane-wa-6-1-01d2400/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
